    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BreathEffect
    Makes a whole text segment gently grow and shrink while its color brightens and darkens.
    ChromaGlitchEffect
    Changes each glyph among palette colors and occasionally nudges it sideways.
    ChromaticAPI
    Registers formatting codes and gives render callbacks access to the current glyph context.
    ChromaticBidi
    Applies native ICU shaping and visual ordering while retaining each glyph's source style.
    ChromaticCodesMod
    Starts Chromatic Codes and connects its shared text API to the current Minecraft side.
    ChromaticColors
    Provides source-compatible color registration and map views backed by shared definitions.
    ChromaticDefinitions
    Stores the colors, effects and outlines currently registered for formatted text.
    ChromaticDefinitions.Binding
    Stores one exact declaration; cleanup uses object identity rather than record equality.
    ChromaticDefinitions.Editor
    Private mutable draft, usable only inside the callback supplied to the owner.
    ChromaticDefinitions.Kind
    Categories of declarations, each with one trigger/value contract.
    ChromaticDefinitions.Registration
    Cleanup receipt tied to one exact declaration object.
    ChromaticDefinitions.Snapshot
    Provides the lookup tables from one complete publication.
    ChromaticEffects
    Offers direct effect registration and lookup by resource identity.
    ChromaticFontMixin
    Connects shared formatting layouts to Minecraft 1.12.2's actual FontRenderer.
    ChromaticGalleryScreen
    Interactive font gallery.
    ChromaticGlyph
    Adapts native font glyph vertices to the sampled effect without replacing Minecraft's font.
    ChromaticGlyph.Plan
    Captures one glyph pass's sampled transform and its four corner colors/alphas.
    ChromaticGlyph.Scope
    Saves one rich-text draw's parent context and OpenGL state, then restores it on closure.
    ChromaticGroovyPlugin
    Optional GroovyScript discovery entry point exposing mods.chromatic_codes.text.
    ChromaticGroovyPlugin.Container
    GroovyScript scans this container's named registry fields.
    ChromaticGroovyPlugin.Declaration
    One unpublished script declaration; no global state is changed by constructing it.
    ChromaticGroovyPlugin.Movements
    Reloadable factory draft.
    ChromaticGroovyPlugin.Text
    Stages one script contribution and publishes it after the script loader finishes.
    ChromaticText
    Parses formatting instructions into visible glyphs and the style attached to each glyph.
    ChromaticText.Glyph
    Associates visible character text with its source slice and complete style.
    ChromaticText.Layout
    Stores a parsed string without losing complete token/code-point source boundaries.
    ChromaticText.Style
    Carries all formatting state needed to draw a glyph and continue it on another line.
    ChromaticUv
    Provides glyph-local texture wrapping geometry without sampling neighboring font-atlas cells.
    ChromaticUv.Vertex
    Stores one geometry position and its corresponding font-atlas texture coordinate.
    ChromaWaveEffect
    Slides a rainbow color field across otherwise stationary text.
    ClientProxy
    Installs local formatting preferences and reloads them when the client reloads its resources.
    ColorHelper
    Contains the shared RGB interpolation and repeatable glyph-noise calculations.
    CommonProxy
    Provides the server-safe half of startup, with no references to client rendering classes.
    CompressEffect
    Alternates horizontal stretching with vertical compression for the complete segment.
    ConfigurableTextEffect
    Defines the supported options and validation rules for built-in effects.
    ConfigurableTextEffect.Parameter
    Describes the accepted shape of one option, independently of its effect-specific default.
    CraftTweakerInspection
    Detached glyph/style view for editor integrations; all offsets are UTF-16 source positions.
    CraftTweakerInspection.StyleView
    Formatting state shared by a complete glyph, including token and segment metadata.
    CraftTweakerText
    Optional startup-action facade imported as mods.chromaticcodes.Text in ZenScript.
    CraftTweakerText.CharacterWidth
    Width of one UTF-16 character, supplied by the caller's actual font metrics.
    CraftTweakerText.ClockAction
    Synchronous operation inside a deterministic effect-clock scope.
    CraftTweakerText.ColorCallback
    Color callback with integer RGB output.
    CraftTweakerText.CustomEffect
    Named callbacks avoid channel-name typos; build consumes the draft exactly once.
    CraftTweakerText.Effect
    Mutable ZenScript effect description; configure completely before passing it to a registration method.
    CraftTweakerText.EffectSampler
    A custom effect sampler.
    CraftTweakerText.Layout
    Immutable shared-parser layout with ZenScript-friendly access to the original glyph/style data.
    CraftTweakerText.PositionCallback
    Position-dependent numeric callback.
    CraftTweakerText.RgbCallback
    Supplies an outline color independently of glyph position and foreground color.
    CraftTweakerText.ScalarCallback
    Position-independent numeric callback.
    CustomItalicEffect
    Leans the top of each glyph sideways using a configurable slant.
    DefaultTextStyles
    Supplies editable, deduplicated bundled definitions; never registers a hidden fallback catalog.
    DefinitionBatch
    One unpublished formatting contribution, validated and installed in a single shared registry edit.
    DefinitionBatch.Receipt
    Lifetime and outcome of one exact batch; older receipts never remove newer owners.
    DiscordGradientEffect
    Paints a stationary horizontal gradient through the supplied palette.
    DynamicEffect
    Provides a vertical wave for wave and a stationary color pattern for none.
    EffectBuilder
    Builds an effect from functions that choose its color, position, opacity, or size.
    EffectBuilder.Color
    Callback for the color channel; called on the thread measuring or drawing the text.
    EffectBuilder.OffsetX
    Callback for the offsetX channel; called on the thread measuring or drawing the text.
    EffectBuilder.OffsetY
    Callback for the offsetY channel; called on the thread measuring or drawing the text.
    EffectBuilder.Opacity
    Callback for the opacity channel; called on the thread measuring or drawing the text.
    EffectBuilder.OutlineColor
    Callback for the outlineColor channel; called on the thread measuring or drawing the text.
    EffectBuilder.Scale
    Callback for the scale channel; called on the thread measuring or drawing the text.
    EffectBuilder.ScaleX
    Callback for the scaleX channel; called on the thread measuring or drawing the text.
    EffectBuilder.ScaleY
    Callback for the scaleY channel; called on the thread measuring or drawing the text.
    EffectMotion
    Shared phase wrapping and smooth repeatable noise for animation calculations.
    EffectOptions
    Keeps reusable colors and option values for creating text effects.
    GalleryAccess
    Opens the native effect gallery through the optional rebindable client shortcut.
    GalleryGuiFactory
    Connects the mod list's Config button to the client-only effect gallery.
    GlitchEffect
    Adds brief, repeatable glyph jumps and color flashes to a flowing gradient.
    GradientEffect
    Cycles smoothly through an RGB palette while optionally borrowing another registered effect's movement.
    IChromaticEffect
    Describes how a piece of formatted text changes its color, position, size or outline.
    InlineEffects
    One-off effect definitions written directly in text, e.g.
    LetterSpacingEffect
    Changes the space between glyphs without stretching their shapes.
    LiquidPlasmaEffect
    Produces a rainbow plasma field from three overlapping sine waves.
    MatrixGrid
    Packs equally sized Matrix cells along a span without squeezing individual glyph shapes.
    MatrixRainEffect
    Keeps a readable foreground word while separate seeded code streams appear above and below it.
    MatrixRainEffect.Cell
    Immutable appearance of one background code symbol at the sampled time.
    MatrixSpinEffect
    Simulates a whole-segment flip by taking the cosine of a shared rotation angle.
    MirroredGradientEffect
    Reflects a stationary palette pattern around the middle of each horizontal span.
    ModOptionsScreen
    Gives the mod's settings and gallery a single parent in Forge's mod list.
    MovementRegistry
    Maps movement names to factories that build actual effect objects.
    MovementRegistry.MovementFactory
    Creates an effect from the registry's palette and two original effect-specific controls.
    MovementScope
    Registers a set of custom effect constructors and removes those exact registrations when closed.
    NativeConfigReader
    Reads configuration through a temporary Forge parser without rewriting the source file.
    PhoenixChromaticCodes
    Supplies the standalone mod identity and a shared logger without loading any client classes.
    PhoenixEffect
    Combines a looping palette gradient with a vertical sine-wave movement.
    PulseEffect
    Moves the entire row of glyphs up and down while its palette flows horizontally.
    RainbowWaveEffect
    Combines a segment-relative rainbow color field with a traveling vertical wave.
    ScaleEffect
    Changes glyph size and its measured advance using a fixed uniform multiplier.
    ShiverEffect
    Jitters each glyph independently in both axes, holding its position until the next jitter interval.
    StaticRainbowEffect
    Cycles the whole text through one shared palette color without moving its glyphs.
    StretchEffect
    Stretches and relaxes a whole text segment horizontally around its center.
    TextConfiguration
    Loads client text settings and updates their registered colors and effects together.
    TextConfiguration.Settings
    Settings read from one configuration file, ready for validation.
    TextEffectClock
    Provides animation time that can be frozen, nested and restored on each calling thread.
    TextEffectClock.Scope
    One entry in the owning thread's clock stack, restored by TextEffectClock.Scope.close().
    TextEffectSegment
    Captures a complete segment's affine transform at the current animation time.
    TextInspection
    Finds visible characters and their styles in formatted text without drawing it.
    TextInspection.Glyph
    One complete code point with its inclusive start and exclusive end in the original source.
    TextInspection.Style
    Detached style metadata; no renderer or script callback is exposed or sampled.
    TextOutlineEffect
    Selects a foreground color and a separate outline decoration.
    TextSettingsScreen
    Edits text preferences with labeled fields and an isolated preview, retaining the existing file format.
    TimedEffect
    Changes animation playback speed without changing the wrapped effect's geometry controls.
    TypefaceDecoration
    Describes the coverage behind a vector glyph in em units.
    TypefaceLayout
    A line's shaped glyphs and their source boundaries, independent of both GPU backends.
    TypefaceLayout.Cluster
    A complete grapheme or ligature.
    TypefaceLayout.MatrixPalette
    Holds code glyphs that belong to the selected face.
    TypefaceLayout.SelectionSpan
    Represents the horizontal extent of a selected visual run.
    TypefaceRender
    Emits vector outlines through Minecraft's existing effect passes.
    Typefaces
    Loads and selects client typefaces without changing the meaning of effect registrations.
    Typefaces.DrawScope
    Prevents a resource replacement from freeing outlines used by an active draw.
    Typefaces.Registration
    Owns one API registration.
    Typefaces.SelectionScope
    Restores the prior selection when a draw or measurement finishes.
    TypefaceSelection
    Chooses how a client draws a typeface.
    TypefaceSelection.MissingGlyph
    Controls the treatment of clusters that no declared family covers.
    TypefaceSelection.Mode
    Chooses how outlines become screen pixels.
    VerticalGradientEffect
    Assigns distinct colors to the top and bottom of each native glyph.
    VerticalShearEffect
    Raises or lowers points across a complete segment in proportion to horizontal distance.
    Volumetric3DEffect
    Adds offset background layers that make text look extruded.
    WobbleEffect
    Moves glyphs along independent horizontal and vertical waves.
    WordFadeEffect
    Fades the foreground from left to right across its current text segment.
